answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: hand out reward weight as trust that flows through the payment graph from a fixed set of long-standing agents. Each link between two agents carries at most 10 units, however many accounts sit behind it. A farm of 1,000 clones joined to the honest network by just 3 links can draw at most 30 units, the same as 3 honest agents, so 997 clones earn nothing. Each real link is a thread the farm must earn by trading honestly for months. Fakes taste no nectar; trust stays set hard like basalt.
